record.field: Draft stage. This event is not shown on the public event homepage yet.
Public event stage. The event is announced and visible on the event homepage while registration is still open.
Registration closed stage. The event is still announced, but users can no longer register because ticket sales or registration have ended.
Finished event stage. The event has ended and should move to history instead of the active event homepage.
Cancelled event stage. The event is hidden from the public homepage and should not accept any more registrations.
